{{Top|leg}}
A '''Senior Intelligence Officer''', commonly referred to simply as '''Senior Officer''', was the title given to the being in charge of a branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Senior Intelligence Officers collected and reviewed data from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and presented the most important and critical information to the [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zgorth'sth]] served as Senior Intelligence Officer of [[Intentions]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
